SCH-CAP-01.title: Day-column headers show a capacity bar - blue fill = aggregate booked vs total available, clamped at 100%, equal track widths
preconditions: 1. You are signed in on a desktop browser.
2. Capacity Bars are ON in View Options (default).
3. Technicians' working hours are known; shifts exist on at least two days with different total booked hours.
4. You are on the Schedule page in week view.
steps: 1. Look at each day column's header bar.
2. Compare a lightly-booked day with a heavily-booked day.
3. Compare the bars' track widths across days.
expected: 1. Each day header shows a capacity bar; the blue fill represents total technician-hours booked divided by total available (sum of all techs' working hours).
2. A more heavily booked day shows a longer blue fill; the fill never exceeds the track (clamped at 100%).
3. The track width is identical across all days (capacity is not rescaled per day), so bars are comparable at a glance.

SCH-CONF-03.title: Before-hours and after-hours shifts are flagged against the tech's hours
